implementation.bootstrap_evaluation: Use fixed out-of-fold predictions; do not refit inside bootstrap. Within each draft class resample stable-player-identity clusters with replacement, same number of clusters as observed. Recompute each cell MAE by renormalizing original inherited occurrence weights inside the bootstrap replicate. Use the same deterministic cluster draws for all candidates. Candidate-minus-C0 is averaged over 12 cells and six classes. One-sided upper 95% is numpy linear 0.95 quantile over exactly 10000 replicates with seed 20260923.
implementation.boundary_saturation_gate_resolution: Before winner ranking, fit each eligible family once on all 2018-2023 development rows solely to evaluate the preregistered hard-bound saturation gate; these all-development diagnostic fits are not used as performance scores. After winner selection, refit only the selected family once and require its parameters/values to reproduce the corresponding boundary diagnostic fit. For C3, the selected alpha edge rule is separate and the embedded C2-prior numeric parameters are checked against C2 hard bounds. Equality to the structural 1414 PAVA anchor is exempt.
implementation.c3_alpha_pseudodraft_formula: For every exact slot and training class, compute the inherited-weight O2 mean; average those class means equally. Let N be the raw number of H3-O2-ready draft occurrences across training classes for that exact slot. Shrunk slot=(N*year-balanced mean + alpha*C2 prior slot)/(N+alpha). Weighted PAVA uses weight N+alpha, enforces non-increasing slots 1-48, then applies hard lower bound 1414. Tier cells are arithmetic means of their four exact slots.
implementation.h2_h4_matching: H2 and mature H4 O2 sensitivity scoring uses only rows with both the requested horizon O2 and H3 O2 available. H2 averages six held-out classes equally; mature H4 averages 2018-2022 classes equally because 2023 H4 would require forbidden partial 2026.
implementation.hard_bound_tolerance: A numeric parameter is at a hard bound when absolute distance to either bound is <= 1e-6 * max(1,abs(lower),abs(upper),abs(upper-lower)).
implementation.loyo_metric_weighting: For every held-out class and metric, each of the 12 R1-R4 cells receives equal 1/12 weight. Within a year-cell, inherited cell_weight_v6_1 is renormalized over rows eligible for that metric. Primary LOYO H3 O2 is the arithmetic mean of the six held-out class macro MAEs.
implementation.lp_tie_break: Solve primary weighted LAD with scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs'). Then constrain LAD objective to optimum + 1e-9*max(1,abs(optimum)) and lexicographically minimize numeric parameters in preregistered parameter order, fixing each resolved parameter before the next.
implementation.o1_shape_scoring: Within each held-out class compute league-weighted H3 O1 mean for each of 12 cells, normalize the empirical 12-cell vector and candidate 12-cell vector to mean 1, take mean absolute shape difference across cells, then average the six held-out class shape errors equally.
